newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Industries sells part of furniture unit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Industries sells part of furniture unit.

text.p: U.S. Industries Inc's Sunlite Casual Furniture has sold its resin outdoor furniture division to an affiliate of U.S. Leisure.
U.S. Leisure is affiliated with Israel's Keter Plastics Ltd, U.S. Industries said in a statement on Monday.
U.S. Industries, which will continue to make metal outdoor furniture, received $10 million cash and a $2.0 million secured note payable on September 15, 1997.
The company plans to retain and transfer equipment valued at approximately $1.5 million to Southeastern Plastics, an affiliate of Ames garden tools.
U.S. Industries expects to realize approximately $6.0 million in additional cash and related tax benefits from the disposal of other assets of the Resin Division not included in the sale.
Neither a gain nor a loss will be recognized in the deal.
The resin furniture operation was part of the outdoor furniture business acquired by U.S. Industries from Sunbeam Corp in March 1997.
The resin operation's revenues for the year ended December 31, 1996, were approximately $37 million and the operating loss was approximately $3.7 million.
